what_this_proves: The self-development engine is reachable from the product and cannot produce an unsafe candidate. A defect assigned by the owner's voice, the Cockpit, the bridge from an evolution opportunity or a red CI is a queued row; a worker on the development machine claims it through the owner's session, runs the engine, and the engine now (a) refuses a patch that carries a secret, a dangerous call, a guarded path, new network egress or a removed test - through a review that cannot run without Grant.SECURITY_REVIEW_CANDIDATE - (b) runs the package's gate in the worktree and feeds a red gate back to the model, (c) runs the committed candidate's API in a real loopback shadow and compares it with the live one, (d) pushes for CI only when the owner enabled it and turns a red CI into one bounded follow-up; the row then waits for the owner, whose approve/reject is minted from a verified owner session and recorded with promoted=false. Nothing in this batch promotes anything (624).

measured_first.cloud_before: app/selfdev had an engine and a CLI that read a hand-written JSON defect; seven real runs (all quarantined) lived in a folder beside the repository; no table, no route, no voice tool, no page listed a run or let the owner decide; Grant.SECURITY_REVIEW_CANDIDATE had no consumer; the reviewer ran regression/targeted/lint/scope only; the engine never ran the full gate, a shadow or a push; fourteen opportunities carried a promotion class nothing consumed; budgets were per-run only (attempts/seconds/tokens), no daily total, no disk floor, no parallel bound.
measured_first.router_before: 'Şu bug'ı kendin düzelt.' -> memory_correct; 'Bu hatayı kendin düzelt.' -> explain/failures; 'Şu özelliği kendine ekle.' -> none; 'Kendinde ne düzeltiyorsun?' -> explain/world_state. Measured with resolve_intent before the block was written.
measured_first.engine_defect_found: GitWorkspace.reset was `git checkout -- .` while diff/changed_paths stage the patch with `git add -A`: after a model-review refusal (or B35's red gate) the second attempt's regression test was judged against the fix still in the index and reported 'PASSED without the fix'. test_the_models_review_can_refuse... only asserted the quarantine and the first failure, so seven real runs had this under them. Reproduced by the new gate fix-loop test (STOPPED expected, QUARANTINED observed), fixed with `git reset -q --hard`, the refusal test now reads the second attempt's checks.

closed_fully.598_680_security_review: security_review.review_candidate(authority, edits, base_texts): CHECK_SECRET (AWS/OpenAI-Anthropic/GitHub key shapes, private key block, credential assignment), CHECK_DANGEROUS_CALL (shell=True, eval, exec, os.system, pickle.loads, __import__, subprocess with a shell string), CHECK_GUARDED_PATH (identity/, security/, authority.py, risk.py, this module, confirmation_gate.py, .github/, secret-store.ps1, scripts/cloud/, scripts/release/, deploy/, infra/, pyproject/uv.lock/package.json/pnpm-lock/requirements/Dockerfile/docker-compose/.env*), CHECK_NETWORK (url literal outside loopback, httpx/requests/urllib/socket - only when the line is new and the hit is not in the base), CHECK_TEST_REMOVAL (fewer `def test_` than the base). The reviewer holds LabAuthority.issue('selfdev-reviewer', {SECURITY_REVIEW_CANDIDATE}); review_candidate calls authority.require(...) and refuses a non-Authority. Engine: after model review approved, gate.run(worktree); ok or skipped -> break; failed -> failure 'gate: ...' into the diagnose/fix loop; record.gate + attempt['gate']. NoGate -> skipped with its reason in the record.
closed_fully.601_ci_trigger: GitPushTrigger(repo, remote, enabled=False): refuses when disabled (detail names PAGENTOS_SELFDEV_CI_PUSH), refuses any branch not selfdev/*, otherwise `git push origin branch:branch`; record.ci_trigger. Worker: --ci-push flag; setting selfdev_ci_push default False.
closed_fully.603_fix_loop: Local: a red gate is one more failure in the attempt loop (diagnosis -> fix_patch -> review again). Remote: SelfDevService.reconcile_ci(state, detail) / POST /defects/{id}/ci - a red CI on an awaiting_owner row opens ONE queued defect (source ci_failure, parent_id, the candidate sha, branch and CI's words in the evidence), bounded by selfdev_max_ci_fix_rounds (the row records ci_fix_rounds_exhausted past it); the same red does not open a second; finish() reconciles automatically when the record's candidate_ci is failure.
closed_fully.608_shadow: ProcessShadowRunner(command template with {port}, package_root, ready_path, probes, live_base_url, startup_timeout_s): free loopback port, Popen in <worktree>/services/api with PAGENTOS_SHADOW=1, waits for the ready path (exit before answering -> failed with the output tail; timeout -> failed 'did not answer'), probes each path on the shadow and (when given) on the live base, Probe.agrees when statuses match, kills the process in finally. ShadowReport.as_dict() with mismatches in the record. Engine runs it on the committed candidate before freeing the worktree; an exception is a failed shadow. Worker default: uvicorn app.main:app --port {port}.

red_first_proof.method: Executed mutations restored from sha256-verified copies (never git checkout); scratchpad b35_mutate.py, log b35_mutate.log.
mutations: M1 the security review's verdict is recorded but never refuses a candidate -> 1 failure (identity boundary committed instead of quarantined).
M2 the review runs without the SECURITY_REVIEW_CANDIDATE grant -> 1 failure (read-only authority reviewed).
M3 dependency manifests and .env files are open to a candidate -> 2 failures (pyproject.toml, package.json/.env params).
M4 a second worker claims while one candidate is running -> 1 failure (parallel_limit not answered).
M5 anything at all can approve a candidate -> 1 failure (object() approved).
M6 the decision's ledger row claims the candidate was promoted -> 1 failure (promoted must be false).

M7 'Bu hatayı düzelt.' (no self-reference) becomes a self-development assignment -> 2 failures (explain and memory-correct neighbours stolen). [v1 of M7 removed a noun guard and turned nothing red: the guard was dead code and was deleted.]
M8 a red gate does not stop the candidate from being committed -> 1 failure (candidate committed under a red gate).
M9 a red CI spawns follow-ups without bound -> 1 failure (grandchild opened past max_ci_fix_rounds).
red_first_proof.result: 9/9 red; every file restored to its sha256 before the mutation

runtime_proof.status: PROVEN_AUTOMATED over the real application object and real processes: the queue's REST surface through create_app with an owner session; the shadow runner against a real loopback subprocess; the engine on a real git repository with real worktrees, pytest and ruff; the voice flow through the real relay, router and tools with the fake desktop (no device call). The production round - a defect assigned by voice on the deployed Cloud Core, claimed by the worker on the owner's machine from the COMMITTED tree, gated, shadowed and decided in the Cockpit - needs the commit this batch series is holding back and is READY_FOR_OWNER (the worker's base SHA is HEAD; today HEAD predates B30-B35).
